headline.bm: Putrajaya lancar Dasar Keselamatan Negara baharu ketika Hormuz hampir tertutup dengan Brent sekitar $96; Zelenskiy beri amaran serangan besar Rusia lagi, dan Nvidia dilaporkan henti penghantaran pelayan AI ke Malaysia.
headline.en: Putrajaya launches a new National Security Policy as Hormuz stays near-shut with Brent about $96; Zelenskiy warns of another Russian mass strike, and Nvidia reportedly halts AI server shipments to Malaysia.

summary.bm: Financial Times melaporkan Nvidia meminta rakan seperti Dell dan Supermicro menghentikan penghantaran selepas peraturan baharu Jabatan Perdagangan AS (diumum 16 Nov) menutup lubang awan bagi syarikat China; penyedia awan diberi 90 hari untuk mendapatkan lesen. Bank turut menangguhkan pinjaman sekitar AS$480-500 juta bagi pusat data di Malaysia yang dikaitkan dengan ByteDance; Nvidia dan kerajaan Malaysia belum memberi reaksi dalam laporan yang dilihat.
summary.en: The Financial Times reported Nvidia told partners such as Dell and Supermicro to stop shipments after new US Commerce rules (announced 16 Nov) closed cloud loopholes for Chinese firms; cloud providers get 90 days to obtain licences. Banks also paused a loan of about US$480-500m for a Malaysia data centre tied to ByteDance; neither Nvidia nor Putrajaya has commented in the reports seen.

title.bm: Nvidia dilaporkan henti penghantaran pelayan AI ke Malaysia, Singapura, Thailand dan Indonesia
title.en: Nvidia reportedly halts AI server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia

why.bm: Malaysia meluluskan pelaburan pusat data dan awan RM123.5 bilion pada Jan-Sep 2026, jadi penghentian berpanjangan boleh menjejaskan projek Johor dan sektor ini.
why.en: Malaysia approved RM123.5bn of data-centre and cloud investment in Jan-Sep 2026, so a prolonged halt could hit Johor projects and the sector.

summary.bm: Pertahanan udara Saudi menjatuhkan dua peluru berpandu balistik, satu peluru berpandu pelayaran dan satu dron berhampiran pelabuhan Jeddah sekitar tengah malam; tiada kecederaan orang awam dilaporkan. Utusan AS Jared Kushner berkata Trump mengekalkan semua pilihan terhadap Iran, manakala menteri luar Iran menuduh Israel cuba menarik AS ke perang baharu.
summary.en: Saudi air defences downed two ballistic missiles, a cruise missile and a drone near Jeddah port around midnight; no civilian injuries were reported. US envoy Jared Kushner said Trump keeps all options on Iran, while Iran's foreign minister accused Israel of trying to drag the US into another war.

title.bm: Arab Saudi memintas peluru berpandu dan dron Houthi ke arah Riyadh dan Jeddah; Trump 'kekalkan semua pilihan' terhadap Iran
title.en: Saudi forces intercept Houthi missiles and drones aimed at Riyadh and Jeddah; Trump 'keeps all options open' on Iran

why.bm: Serangan ke atas sasaran Saudi mengekalkan premium risiko minyak Teluk, menambah kos bahan api dan tambang.
why.en: Attacks on Saudi targets keep the Gulf oil risk premium high, feeding fuel and freight costs.

summary.bm: Reuters melaporkan media Iran berkata dua kapal tangki minyak terkena periuk api dan meletup di zon terhad pada Rabu (dakwaan Iran, belum disahkan bebas), mengancam pemulihan aliran Hormuz. Brent ditutup naik 3.5% pada Rabu dan didagangkan sekitar $94.7 awal Khamis; menteri OPEC+ bersidang mulai 29 Nov.
summary.en: Reuters reports Iranian state media said two oil tankers struck mines and exploded in a restricted zone on Wednesday (Iranian claims, not independently confirmed), threatening a recovery in Hormuz flows. Brent closed Wednesday 3.5% higher and traded near $94.7 early Thursday; OPEC+ ministers meet from 29 Nov.

title.bm: Hormuz: Iran dakwa sekurang-kurangnya dua kapal tangki terkena periuk api; Brent melonjak 3.5% kepada sekitar $94.6
title.en: Hormuz: Iran says at least two tankers hit mines; Brent jumps 3.5% to about $94.6

why.bm: Pelayaran melalui Hormuz hampir terhenti, risiko utama bagi kos bahan api dan pengangkutan di Malaysia.
why.en: Shipping through Hormuz stays near a standstill, a key risk for fuel and freight costs in Malaysia.

summary.bm: Cadangan Suruhanjaya Eropah memerlukan persetujuan kesemua 27 negara anggota, menambah lebih 70 kapal ke senarai armada bayangan, melarang firma EU menyediakan perkhidmatan kepada kilang penapis Rusia dan melanjutkan sekatan perkhidmatan tenaga kepada elektrik buat kali pertama. Ia dijangka dibincang pada Majlis Eropah 26–27 Nov; tiada tarikh mula diberikan.
summary.en: The Commission's proposal needs approval from all 27 member states and would add over 70 vessels to the shadow-fleet list, bar EU firms from servicing Russian refineries and extend energy-services curbs to electricity for the first time. It is expected to be discussed at the 26–27 Nov European Council; no start date is given.

title.bm: EU cadang pakej sekatan Rusia ke-22, termasuk larangan kapal tangki berinsurans Rusia
title.en: EU proposes 22nd Russia sanctions package, including ban on Russia-insured tankers

why.bm: Sekatan lebih ketat ke atas eksport minyak Rusia boleh menjejaskan harga tenaga dan insurans kapal tangki di seluruh dunia.
why.en: Tighter curbs on Russian oil exports could affect energy prices and tanker insurance worldwide.

summary.bm: Warsaw mengumumkan zon larangan terbang di sepanjang sempadan Ukraine, manakala lebih 30 negara menggesa Rusia berhenti menggunakan agen kimia seperti gas CS. Berasingan, Ukraine berkata ia menyerang sebuah pangkalan udara Rusia dan merosakkan lima pesawat.
summary.en: Warsaw announced a no-fly zone along its Ukrainian border, while more than 30 countries called on Russia to stop using chemical agents such as CS gas. Separately, Ukraine says it hit a Russian air base and damaged five aircraft.

title.bm: Poland umum zon larangan terbang berhampiran sempadan Ukraine; 30+ negara gesa Moscow henti guna agen kimia
title.en: Poland announces no-fly zone near Ukrainian border; 30+ countries urge Moscow to stop using chemical agents

why.bm: Menunjukkan sayap timur NATO kian diperketat apabila perang meningkat.
why.en: Signals NATO's eastern flank is tightening amid the war's escalation.

summary.bm: Pyongyang mengusir diplomat tertinggi Switzerland selepas Switzerland mengenakan sekatan ke atas kem kanak-kanak Songdowon. Kim Jong Un turut menggesa penempatan senjata nuklear taktikal yang lebih luas.
summary.en: Pyongyang expelled Switzerland's top diplomat after Swiss sanctions on the Songdowon children's camp. Kim Jong Un also called for wider deployment of tactical nuclear weapons.

title.bm: Korea Utara arah diplomat tertinggi Switzerland keluar dalam 48 jam; Kim gesa penempatan nuklear taktikal lebih luas
title.en: North Korea orders Swiss top diplomat out within 48 hours; Kim urges wider tactical-nuke deployment

why.bm: Menambah ketegangan di Semenanjung Korea, relevan kepada keselamatan dan pasaran Asia-Pasifik.
why.en: Adds to tension on the Korean peninsula, relevant to Asia-Pacific security and markets.

summary.bm: Hakim mengesyorkan Kes 4000 terhadap Perdana Menteri sementara Benjamin Netanyahu digugurkan dan mempersoalkan kes kedua; Netanyahu menggesa perbicaraan ditamatkan.
summary.en: Judges recommended dropping Case 4000 against caretaker PM Benjamin Netanyahu and questioned a second case; Netanyahu called for the trial to end.

title.bm: Hakim Israel syor Kes 4000 terhadap Netanyahu digugurkan
title.en: Israeli judges recommend dropping Case 4000 against Netanyahu

why.bm: Mempengaruhi hala tuju politik Israel dan dasar serantaunya.
why.en: Affects Israel's political direction and its regional policy.

summary.bm: Miti berkata Malaysia akan terus berunding dengan Washington sehingga suku pertama 2027 supaya jumlah tarif AS kekal dalam had 19% di bawah Perjanjian Perdagangan Timbal Balik; AS membayangkan julat 18–25% di bawah Seksyen 301. Malaysia antara 14 ekonomi yang berdepan cadangan tarif Seksyen 301 sebanyak 15–35%.
summary.en: Miti says Malaysia will keep negotiating with Washington into Q1 2027 so total US tariffs stay within the 19% ceiling agreed under the Agreement on Reciprocal Trade; the US has signalled an 18–25% range under Section 301. Malaysia is one of 14 economies facing proposed Section 301 tariffs of 15–35%.

title.bm: AS cadang tarif Seksyen 301 sehingga 18% ke atas barangan Malaysia, 25% jika rundingan gagal
title.en: US proposes Section 301 tariffs of up to 18% on Malaysian goods, 25% if talks falter

why.bm: Menjejaskan pengeksport Malaysia, terutama elektronik dan komponen automotif; Malaysia menegaskan rejim perdagangannya berasaskan peraturan dan pasaran.
why.en: Hits Malaysian exporters, especially electronics and auto parts; Malaysia says it runs a rule-based, market-based trade regime.

summary.bm: Dalam 'Dialog Negara: Di Sebalik Keputusan' di RTM, Anwar berkata PRU16 boleh diadakan sebelum atau selepas Hari Merdeka tahun depan, manakala komposisi kerajaan selepas itu bergantung kepada keputusan dan sokongan parti. Topik lain termasuk pembangunan semula bandar, perkhidmatan kesihatan awam, pendidikan kesihatan mental, cadangan dana kekayaan AI dan antirasuah.
summary.en: On RTM's 'Dialog Negara: Di Sebalik Keputusan', Anwar said the 16th general election could fall before or after Merdeka Day next year, with the post-election government depending on results and party support. Topics also included urban redevelopment, public health services, mental health education, a proposed AI wealth fund and anti-corruption.

title.bm: Anwar: PRU16 mesti diadakan sebelum Februari 2028, minta rakyat bersabar
title.en: Anwar: GE16 must be held before February 2028, asks public to be patient

why.bm: Menetapkan had masa pilihan raya umum akan datang dan mempengaruhi kiraan politik menjelang Bajet 2027 dan PRN.
why.en: Sets the outer limit for the next election and keeps political calculations alive for Budget 2027 and state polls.

summary.bm: Dalam Dialog Negara RTM, Perdana Menteri berkata rasuah telah menjadi sistemik dan tindakan tegas mesti diteruskan, dengan populariti bukan keutamaan. Beliau berkata SPRM mesti bebas menyiasat tanpa campur tangan dan beliau tidak masuk campur dalam siasatan membabitkan bekas setiausaha politiknya.
summary.en: On RTM's Dialog Negara, the PM said corruption has become systemic and decisive action must continue, adding that popularity is secondary. He said MACC must be free to investigate without interference and that he stayed out of the probe involving a former aide.

title.bm: Anwar: rasuah sistemik, kerajaan akan terus memeranginya sama ada popular atau tidak
title.en: Anwar: corruption is systemic, government will keep fighting it "popular or not"

why.bm: Menunjukkan pendirian kerajaan mengenai antirasuah menjelang PRU16 dan PRN Sarawak.
why.en: Signals the government line on anti-graft ahead of GE16 and the Sarawak polls.

summary.bm: Menteri Wilayah Persekutuan berkata pembantunya diminta membantu SPRM berhubung pembaharuan pajakan 99 tahun Dewan Perhimpunan Cina KL & Selangor pada premium RM1,000, berbanding anggaran awal hampir RM4.67 juta. Beliau berkata keputusan dibuat jawatankuasa yang dipengerusikan Ketua Setiausaha Negara, dan tujuh pertubuhan KL lain menerima premium nominal serupa.
summary.en: The Federal Territories Minister said her aide was asked to assist MACC over the 99-year lease renewal for the KL & Selangor Chinese Assembly Hall at a RM1,000 premium, against an earlier estimate of nearly RM4.67 million. She said a committee chaired by the chief secretary decided it, and seven other KL organisations got similar nominal premiums.

title.bm: Hannah Yeoh sahkan SPRM panggil pembantunya berkenaan pembaharuan pajakan KLSCAH RM1,000
title.en: Hannah Yeoh confirms MACC summoned her aide over RM1,000 KLSCAH lease renewal

why.bm: Ujian ketelusan keputusan pajakan tanah yang membabitkan pejabat seorang menteri.
why.en: A test of transparency in land-lease decisions involving a sitting minister’s office.

summary.bm: Ketua Pembangkang Hamzah Zainudin meminta penjelasan mengenai penyahrahsiaan minit itu, dengan berkata Majlis Peguam belum menerimanya setakat 25 Nov dan bertanya sama ada Yang di-Pertuan Agong dirujuk. Takiyuddin dari PN berkata tiada afidavit AGC bersama dokumen itu ditemui dalam sistem e-filing Mahkamah Persekutuan pada 24 Nov.
summary.en: Opposition Leader Hamzah Zainudin asked for clarification on declassifying the minutes, saying the Malaysian Bar had not received them by 25 Nov and asking whether the Agong was consulted. PN's Takiyuddin said no AGC affidavit with the document was found on the Federal Court e-filing system on 24 Nov.

title.bm: Perikatan pertikai minit Lembaga Pengampunan Najib yang dinyahrahsiakan
title.en: Perikatan questions declassified Pardons Board minutes on Najib's house arrest

why.bm: Isu pengampunan diraja yang sensitif terus hangat di Parlimen dan mahkamah.
why.en: Keeps a politically sensitive royal-pardon issue alive in Parliament and the courts.

summary.bm: Anwar mengingatkan agar hubungan dengan AS tidak dipandang remeh walaupun ada pertikaian tarif, dengan dasar berberkecuali membolehkan Malaysia berurusan dengan Washington, Beijing dan Moscow. Malaysia Aviation Group mengumumkan pembelian 10 Boeing 787 Dreamliner dengan pilihan enam lagi.
summary.en: Anwar warned against underestimating ties with the US despite tariff disputes, saying Malaysia's neutrality lets it deal with Washington, Beijing and Moscow. Malaysia Aviation Group announced it will acquire 10 Boeing 787 Dreamliners with an option for six more.

title.bm: Anwar: AS kekal rakan dagang dan pelaburan utama; MAG beli 10 Boeing 787
title.en: Anwar: US remains top trade and investment partner; MAG to buy 10 Boeing 787s

why.bm: Menunjukkan cara Malaysia mengimbangi tekanan tarif AS dan hubungan dengan China, dengan kesan kepada pengeksport dan sektor penerbangan.
why.en: Signals how Malaysia balances US tariff pressure and China ties, with effects on exporters and the airline sector.

summary.bm: Anwar memberitahu Dewan Rakyat bahawa Bahagian Hal Ehwal Undang-undang (BHEUU) Jabatan Perdana Menteri dan Jabatan Peguam Negara tidak membocorkan minit rahsia berkaitan tahanan rumah Najib; AGC hanya menyahklasifikasi sebahagian dokumen bagi menyediakan jawapan kerajaan di mahkamah. Ini susulan perintah Mahkamah Tinggi pada 10 Nov supaya Najib menjalani baki hukuman SRC di rumah, yang kini dicabar Majlis Peguam. Polis kini menyiasat kebocoran itu: Menteri Dalam Negeri Saifuddin berkata polis akan menyiasat dan KPN menyatakan Tony Pua mungkin dipanggil, walaupun FMT melaporkan tiada laporan polis difailkan terhadapnya setakat Selasa. The Edge melaporkan KPN berkata polis mungkin memanggil Tony Pua (DAP) berhubung kebocoran minit Lembaga Pengampunan.
summary.en: Anwar told the Dewan Rakyat the PM's Department legal affairs division (BHEUU) and the Attorney General's Chambers did not leak the classified minutes on Najib's house arrest; the AGC only declassified parts to prepare the government's court reply. This follows the Nov 10 High Court order that Najib serve the rest of his SRC sentence at home, which the Malaysian Bar is now challenging. Police are now investigating the leak: the Home Minister Saifuddin says police will investigate and the IGP says DAP's Tony Pua may be summoned, though FMT reported no police report had been filed against him as of Tuesday. The Edge reports the IGP says police may summon DAP's Tony Pua over the leak of the Pardons Board minutes.

title.bm: Anwar nafi kerajaan bocorkan minit Lembaga Pengampunan Najib, minta KDN siasat
title.en: Anwar denies government leaked Najib pardon-board minutes, says Home Ministry should probe

why.bm: Ujian ketelusan dan proses pengampunan berprofil tinggi menjelang pendengaran mahkamah seterusnya.
why.en: A high-profile test of transparency and the pardons process ahead of further court hearings.

summary.bm: AS mengumumkan tarif berkaitan 'pengeluaran berlebihan' membabitkan 14 entiti ekonomi termasuk Korea Selatan; had 15% dalam perjanjian dagang Seoul dikekalkan, tetapi Washington membuka ruang menaikkannya ke 25% kelak. Indeks PCE Oktober meningkat, dengan inflasi teras tertinggi sejak 2023, menguatkan jangkaan kenaikan kadar Fed pada Disember.
summary.en: The US announced tariffs aimed at 'overproduction' covering 14 economic entities including South Korea; Seoul's 15% cap under its trade deal was kept, but Washington left room to raise it to 25% later. The October PCE index rose, with core inflation the highest since 2023, firming expectations of a Fed rate hike in December.

title.bm: Tarif AS 'pengeluaran berlebihan' sasar 14 entiti ekonomi; inflasi teras Oktober tertinggi sejak 2023, jangkaan kenaikan kadar Fed menguat
title.en: US tariffs on 'overproduction' target 14 economies; October core inflation highest since 2023, Fed hike bets firm up

why.bm: Kadar AS yang tinggi dan tarif lebih luas menekan ringgit, ekonomi Asia berorientasi eksport dan pengeksport Malaysia.
why.en: Higher-for-longer US rates and wider tariffs pressure the ringgit, export-driven Asian economies and Malaysian exporters.

summary.bm: S&P 500 jatuh sehingga 3.2% semasa dagangan sebelum mengurangkan kerugian (susut sekitar 0.3% pada 3:07 ptg ET), manakala Nasdaq susut 0.8% selepas jatuh 4.6% awal. Inflasi PCE Oktober naik kepada 3.8% daripada 3.6%; laporan menyebut Fed berkemungkinan menaikkan kadar pada Disember. Kospi jatuh 6.2% dan Nikkei 2.8%.
summary.en: The S&P 500 fell as much as 3.2% intraday before trimming losses (down about 0.3% at 3:07pm ET), while Nasdaq was down 0.8% after an early 4.6% drop. October PCE inflation rose to 3.8% from 3.6%, the article says the Fed is likely to hike in December; Kospi fell 6.2% and Nikkei 2.8%.

title.bm: Wall Street kurangkan kerugian rout AI; inflasi PCE AS 3.8%, kenaikan kadar Fed dijangka Disember
title.en: Wall St pares AI-rout losses; US PCE inflation hits 3.8% and Fed hike seen in December

why.bm: Kadar AS lebih tinggi dan kebimbangan saham AI boleh menekan ringgit, Bursa dan pengeksport teknologi Malaysia.
why.en: Higher US rates and AI-stock jitters can weigh on ringgit, Bursa and Malaysian tech exporters.

summary.bm: AP melaporkan Kospi jatuh 5.6% ke 4,725.84 (Samsung -9.1%), Nikkei 225 susut 3.6% (SoftBank -16.1%) dan TSMC merosot 8.1%, manakala Hang Seng naik 1%. Di Wall Street, S&P 500 turun 0.5% untuk kerugian kelapan dalam sembilan hari; Nvidia jatuh 5.9% dan Anthropic ditutup bawah harga IPO $83.
summary.en: AP reports Kospi fell 5.6% to 4,725.84 (Samsung -9.1%), Nikkei 225 lost 3.6% (SoftBank -16.1%) and TSMC dropped 8.1%, while Hang Seng rose 1%. On Wall Street the S&P 500 fell 0.5% for an eighth loss in nine days; Nvidia fell 5.9% and Anthropic closed below its $83 IPO price.

title.bm: Saham Asia jatuh akibat jualan AI: Kospi -5.6%, Nikkei -3.6%, Taiex susut lebih 6%
title.en: Asian stocks tumble on AI selloff: Kospi -5.6%, Nikkei -3.6%, Taiex down over 6%

why.bm: Turun naik saham cip dan AI boleh menjejas saham semikonduktor Malaysia, KLCI dan pelaburan berkaitan.
why.en: Semiconductor and AI-linked volatility may hit Malaysian chip stocks, KLCI and EPF-linked investments.

summary.bm: WSJ, Reuters dan FT melaporkan Washington sedang menyediakan tarif lebih tinggi, dengan rakan perjanjian mungkin dihadkan. Nasdaq jatuh 1.5% dan S&P 500 sekitar 0.5% pada Selasa, manakala Dow naik; keyakinan pengguna AS 103.3 berbanding jangkaan 92.5.
summary.en: WSJ, Reuters and FT reported Washington is preparing higher tariffs, with deal partners possibly capped. The Nasdaq fell 1.5% and the S&P 500 about 0.5% on Tuesday, while the Dow rose; US consumer confidence came in at 103.3 versus 92.5 expected.

title.bm: AS dilapor sedia naikkan tarif ke atas China, EU dan lain-lain; Wall Street susut selepas rali Nvidia
title.en: US reported preparing tariff increases on China, EU and others; Wall Street slips after Nvidia-led rally

why.bm: Tarif baharu boleh menjejaskan pengeksport Malaysia, ringgit dan pasaran serantau.
why.en: New tariffs could hit Malaysian exporters, ringgit and regional markets.

summary.bm: Sebuah lori tangki bahan api terbalik dan terbakar di jalan lingkar Warraq, Kaherah, petang Rabu, mengorbankan sekurang-kurangnya 31 orang dan mencederakan 21, menurut kementerian kesihatan Mesir.
summary.en: A fuel tanker overturned and burned on Cairo's Warraq ring road on Wednesday evening, killing at least 31 and injuring 21, according to Egypt's health ministry.

title.bm: Kebakaran lori tangki bahan api di Kaherah korbankan sekurang-kurangnya 31
title.en: Cairo fuel tanker fire kills at least 31

why.bm: Antara tragedi jalan raya paling maut minggu ini.
why.en: One of the deadliest road disasters of the week; a reminder of fuel-transport safety risks.

summary.bm: Brent ditutup turun 3.5% pada $89.37 Isnin dan kekal sekitar $89.50 Selasa kerana bekalan meningkat mengatasi risiko Hormuz. Hasil bon AS 10 tahun ialah 4.94%.
summary.en: Brent settled down 3.5% at $89.37 on Monday and held about $89.50 on Tuesday as rising supply offset Hormuz risk. The 10-year US yield is 4.94%.

title.bm: Brent turun ke paras hampir terendah tiga bulan sekitar $89 manakala dolar kekal hampir tertinggi 19 bulan
title.en: Brent slips to near three-month low around $89 as dollar stays near 19-month high

why.bm: Minyak mentah lebih rendah meredakan tekanan kos bahan api, tetapi dolar kukuh membebankan ringgit.
why.en: Lower crude eases fuel-cost pressure, but a strong dollar weighs on the ringgit.

summary.bm: Penyerang menghubungkan kelemahan ini dengan PHP2Shell untuk mendapat akses root pada firewall yang terdedah ke internet; sebuah firma keselamatan melaporkan 24 firewall terjejas di satu organisasi. Palo Alto telah mengeluarkan hotfix.
summary.en: Attackers are chaining the flaw with PHP2Shell to take root on internet-exposed firewalls; one security firm reported 24 firewalls compromised at a single organisation. Palo Alto has a hotfix.

title.bm: Kelemahan PAN-OS Palo Alto 'Fragnesia' (CVE-2026-46300) dieksploitasi untuk akses root pada firewall terdedah
title.en: Palo Alto PAN-OS flaw 'Fragnesia' (CVE-2026-46300) exploited to gain root on exposed firewalls

why.bm: Kelemahan peranti rangkaian: pasang hotfix dan sekat akses internet ke antara muka pengurusan.
why.en: Network-device flaw: install the hotfix and block internet access to the management interface.

summary.bm: Token itu, dicuri pada 19 Nov, turut mendedahkan metadata akaun terhad; rahsia peti simpanan tidak diambil.
summary.en: The token, stolen on 19 Nov, also exposed limited account metadata; vault secrets were not taken.

title.bm: 1Password berkata token GitHub pekerja yang dicuri digunakan untuk menyalin kod sumber persendirian
title.en: 1Password says a stolen employee GitHub token was used to copy private source code

why.bm: Data peti simpanan dilaporkan selamat; kekalkan 2FA dan berwaspada terhadap pancingan data yang menyebut insiden ini.
why.en: Vault data is reported safe; keep 2FA on and watch for phishing that mentions the incident.

summary.bm: Nasihat VMSA-2026-0011 (24 Nov) merangkumi ESX, vCenter, Workstation, Fusion, Tools dan Avi Load Balancer. CVE-2026-123903 yang kritikal pada vmdir vCenter boleh dicapai melalui rangkaian tanpa keistimewaan; eksploitasi aktif belum disahkan.
summary.en: Advisory VMSA-2026-0011 (24 Nov) covers ESX, vCenter, Workstation, Fusion, Tools and Avi Load Balancer. The critical CVE-2026-123903 in vCenter's vmdir is network-reachable and needs no privileges; exploitation in the wild is not yet established.

title.bm: Broadcom tampal 23 kelemahan VMware termasuk pintasan pengesahan vCenter kritikal (CVSS 9.8)
title.en: Broadcom patches 23 VMware flaws incl. critical vCenter authentication bypass (CVSS 9.8)

why.bm: Semak Response Matrix dan tampal vCenter/ESX segera; hadkan pendedahan rangkaian pengurusan.
why.en: Check the Response Matrix and patch vCenter/ESX promptly; limit management-network exposure.

summary.bm: Decathlon mengesahkan serangan siber mendedahkan data pelanggan, termasuk lebih 130,000 alamat e-mel, menurut Sinar Harian.
summary.en: Decathlon confirmed a cyberattack exposed customer data, including more than 130,000 email addresses, according to Sinar Harian.

title.bm: Decathlon sahkan serangan siber dedah data pelanggan, termasuk lebih 130,000 alamat e-mel
title.en: Decathlon confirms cyberattack exposing customer data, incl. over 130,000 email addresses

why.bm: Jika anda pelanggan Decathlon, berwaspada terhadap e-mel pancingan data dan jangan klik pautan yang tidak dijangka.
why.en: If you shop at Decathlon, watch for phishing emails and avoid clicking unexpected links.

summary.bm: GreyNoise berkata kumpulan itu menyerang kira-kira 22 organisasi antara 17 Okt dan 2 Nov dan menyalin data firewall; satu tajuk media menyebut 24 pelayan.
summary.en: GreyNoise says the group hit about 22 organisations between 17 Oct and 2 Nov and copied firewall data; one outlet's headline says 24 servers.

title.bm: Pelayan pengurusan Check Point diserang kumpulan 'GT13' menggunakan CVE-2026-16232
title.en: Check Point management servers hit by group 'GT13' using CVE-2026-16232

why.bm: Jika anda menggunakan pengurusan Check Point, pasang pembaikan vendor dan hadkan akses pengurusan.
why.en: If you run Check Point management, apply the vendor fix and restrict management access.

summary.bm: FCC meluluskan pelan 'Starmind' SpaceX untuk sehingga 1 juta satelit pusat data orbit hingga 2040, dengan penempatan bermula menjelang November 2033, menurut Pengerusi Brendan Carr.
summary.en: The FCC approved SpaceX's 'Starmind' plan for up to 1 million orbital data-centre satellites through 2040, with deployment to begin by November 2033, according to Chairman Brendan Carr.

title.bm: FCC lulus SpaceX untuk sehingga 1 juta satelit pusat data orbit
title.en: FCC approves SpaceX for up to 1 million orbital data-centre satellites

why.bm: Langkah besar bagi pengkomputeran angkasa, dengan implikasi kepada pasaran pusat data dan satelit.
why.en: A major step for space-based computing, with implications for data-centre and satellite markets.

summary.bm: Mahkamah AS mensabitkan Huawei China dalam perbicaraan jenayah besar berkaitan perniagaannya dengan Iran.
summary.en: A US court convicted China's Huawei in a sprawling criminal trial over its Iran-related business.

title.bm: Huawei disabit bersalah atas 10 daripada 12 pertuduhan dalam perbicaraan jenayah AS berkaitan Iran
title.en: Huawei convicted on 10 of 12 counts in US criminal trial over Iran business

why.bm: Meningkatkan ketegangan teknologi AS-China dan risiko bagi syarikat yang menggunakan peralatan Huawei.
why.en: Raises US-China tech tension and risk for firms using Huawei gear.

summary.bm: Memo dilapor Reuters menyebut gangguan 12-13 Nov berpunca daripada kecacatan skala Windows sejak Julai, dengan lebih 80% get laluan terjejas tidak bertindak balas. Microsoft menegaskan ia bukan serangan siber dan menyasarkan pemulihan insiden akan datang dalam sejam.
summary.en: Memos reported by Reuters say the 12-13 Nov outage was traced to an undetected Windows scalability defect from July, with over 80% of affected gateways unresponsive. Microsoft says it was not a cyberattack and aims to resolve future incidents within an hour.

title.bm: Microsoft isytihar 'Code Red' selepas gangguan Microsoft 365 rekod 24 jam
title.en: Microsoft declares 'Code Red' after record 24-hour Microsoft 365 outage

why.bm: Menunjukkan risiko kebergantungan awan bagi perniagaan yang bergantung pada Microsoft 365.
why.en: Shows the cloud-concentration risk for businesses that depend on Microsoft 365.

summary.bm: Nvidia berkata Huang kembali sebagai CEO serta-merta, 11 hari selepas beliau meletak jawatan pada 12 Nov; lembaga berkata siasatan bebasnya akan diteruskan hingga selesai dan sebuah jawatankuasa keselamatan negara dan kawalan eksport ditubuhkan. Saham melonjak mendadak sebelum dan semasa pasaran dibuka.
summary.en: Nvidia said Huang returns as CEO effective immediately, 11 days after he resigned on 12 Nov; the board says its independent investigation will proceed to conclusion and a national security and export-control committee has been set up. Shares jumped sharply premarket and at the open.

title.bm: Nvidia melantik semula Jensen Huang sebagai CEO; saham melonjak, siasatan diteruskan
title.en: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO; shares leap and the investigation continues

why.bm: Nvidia menjadi tunggak rantaian cip AI yang bergantung kepada sektor pusat data dan semikonduktor Malaysia.
why.en: Nvidia anchors the AI chip chain that Malaysia's data-centre and semiconductor sectors rely on.

summary.bm: Satu ringkasan melaporkan pakej ini menambah Code Review (kini tersedia umum), PR Steward dan Claude Approvals, dicetus dengan /ship dalam Claude Code. Organisasi Enterprise layak boleh menuntut kredit $10,000 sebelum 15 Jan 2027; ini daripada ringkasan sekunder, bukan laman Anthropic.
summary.en: A digest reports the bundle adds Code Review (now generally available), PR Steward and Claude Approvals, triggered by /ship in Claude Code. Eligible Enterprise organisations can claim $10,000 in credits by 15 Jan 2027; this is from a secondary digest, not Anthropic's page.

title.bm: Anthropic lancar beta Claude Ship untuk pelan Team dan Enterprise
title.en: Anthropic releases Claude Ship beta for Team and Enterprise

why.bm: Menunjukkan ejen pengekodan AI beralih ke aliran kelulusan dan keluaran; sahkan di laman Anthropic.
why.en: Shows AI coding agents moving into approvals and release workflows; verify on Anthropic's site.

summary.bm: Surat berita melaporkan Anthropic menetapkan harga IPO $83 dan didagangkan sebagai ANT, dengan pemfailan menunjukkan perbelanjaan pengkomputeran sehingga $120.5 bilion dengan SpaceX hingga 2029. Ia juga memendekkan tempoh pendedahan kerentanan terkoordinasi daripada 90 kepada 30 hari mulai 1 Januari; angka berbeza sedikit antara surat berita.
summary.en: Newsletters report Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 and trades as ANT, and that its filing shows up to $120.5bn of compute spending with SpaceX through 2029. It will also shorten its coordinated vulnerability disclosure window from 90 to 30 days from 1 January; figures differ slightly between newsletters.

title.bm: Butiran IPO Anthropic: kira-kira $83 sesaham, tempoh pendedahan kerentanan 30 hari mulai Januari
title.en: Anthropic IPO details: about $83 a share, 30-day vulnerability disclosure window from January

why.bm: Tempoh pendedahan lebih pendek bermakna pasukan IT ada masa lebih singkat untuk menampal selepas kerentanan dilaporkan.
why.en: Shorter disclosure windows mean IT teams get less time to patch after a flaw is reported.

summary.bm: Levent Alpöge berkata hujah-hujah itu diformalkan tanpa andaian, dilaporkan dalam Lean. Bukti itu belum disahkan secara bebas. Pada 21 Nov komuniti Lean dan Mathlib menyatakan keyakinan penuh terhadap bukti Lean sekitar 17 juta baris itu, dan binaan semula bebas menghasilkan keputusan sama; Institut Clay masih menyenaraikan masalah itu sebagai terbuka.
summary.en: Levent Alpöge says arguments were formalised without assumptions, reportedly in Lean. The proof has not been independently verified. On 21 Nov the Lean and Mathlib communities said they had full confidence in the roughly 17-million-line Lean proof, and independent rebuilds reproduced it; the Clay Institute still lists the problem as open.

title.bm: Ahli matematik Anthropic dakwa beliau dan Claude menemui bukti hipotesis Riemann (belum disahkan)
title.en: Anthropic mathematician says he and Claude found a proof of the Riemann hypothesis (unverified)

why.bm: Anggap sebagai dakwaan belum disahkan sehingga disemak ahli matematik bebas.
why.en: Treat as an unverified claim until independent mathematicians check it.

summary.bm: Dompet ini dibina bersama American Express, Chase, Mastercard dan Visa. OpenAI turut memotong harga API GPT-6.2 Astra sebanyak 20% kepada $8 sejuta token input dan $40 sejuta token output.
summary.en: The wallet was built with American Express, Chase, Mastercard and Visa. OpenAI also cut GPT-6.2 Astra's API price 20% to $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.

title.bm: OpenAI lancar ChatGPT Wallet supaya ejen AI boleh membayar tanpa melihat nombor kad
title.en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet so AI agents can pay without seeing card numbers

why.bm: Pembayaran oleh ejen AI semakin hampir, jadi jangkakan corak penipuan baharu juga.
why.en: Agent-led payments are arriving, so expect new scam and fraud patterns too.

summary.bm: Gemini 4 Neon berharga AS$3 sejuta token input dan AS$15 sejuta token output, menurut rumusan berita AI.
summary.en: Gemini 4 Neon is priced at $3 per million input and $15 per million output tokens, per AI news roundups.

title.bm: Google lancar Gemini 4 Neon dengan konteks 1 juta token
title.en: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon with 1M-token context

why.bm: Pilihan konteks panjang lebih murah untuk pembangun dan perniagaan.
why.en: Cheaper long-context option for developers and businesses.

summary.bm: CIDRAP melaporkan wabak masih merebak dengan kadar kematian kes sekitar 50%. WHO sebelum ini merekodkan lebih 11,000 kes Bundibugyo.
summary.en: CIDRAP reports the outbreak is still spreading with a case-fatality rate around 50%. WHO earlier counted over 11,000 Bundibugyo cases.

title.bm: Ebola di DR Congo genap enam bulan: penularan tidak terkawal dan keganasan baharu
title.en: Ebola in DR Congo at six months: rampant spread and new waves of violence

why.bm: Elakkan perjalanan tidak perlu ke kawasan terjejas dan ikut nasihat KKM.
why.en: Avoid non-essential travel to affected areas and follow KKM advisories.

summary.bm: Virginia melaporkan kematian campak pertama dalam hampir 50 tahun; kes AS menghampiri 6,000 (5,838 setakat 20 Nov).
summary.en: Virginia reports its first measles death in almost 50 years; US cases are near 6,000 (5,838 as of Nov 20).

title.bm: Kematian campak AS cecah 13 apabila Virginia dan Pennsylvania lapor kematian baharu
title.en: US measles deaths reach 13 as Virginia and Pennsylvania report new deaths

why.bm: Semak status vaksin MMR keluarga sebelum bermusafir.
why.en: Check your family's MMR vaccination before travel.

summary.bm: Laporan yang memetik Wall Street Journal menyatakan AS hilang status penghapusan campak selepas penularan berterusan; ABC melaporkan kes seluruh negara melebihi 5,400 dengan 10 kematian. CDC merekodkan 5,412 kes disahkan setakat 13 Nov, naik 230 seminggu. CIDRAP kini merekodkan sekitar 5,838 kes AS.
summary.en: Reports citing the Wall Street Journal say the US lost its measles elimination status after continued spread; ABC reports nationwide cases above 5,400 with 10 deaths. The CDC counted 5,412 confirmed cases by 13 Nov, up 230 in a week. CIDRAP now counts about 5,838 US cases.

title.bm: AS dilaporkan hilang status penghapusan campak apabila kes melebihi 5,400
title.en: US reported to lose measles elimination status as cases top 5,400

why.bm: Semak vaksin MMR anak sebelum melancong ke AS.
why.en: Check children's MMR vaccination before travelling to the US.

summary.bm: Gardenia Malaysia Timur menjelaskan ia entiti berasingan daripada Gardenia KL selepas aduan membabitkan Original Classic White Bread dan Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. KKM menunggu keputusan makmal dan akan memeriksa kilang KL di bawah Akta Makanan 1983; nombor kelompok belum lengkap.
summary.en: Gardenia East Malaysia says it is separate from Gardenia KL after complaints involving Original Classic White Bread and Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. The Health Ministry awaits lab results and will inspect the KL factory under the Food Act 1983; batch numbers are incomplete.

title.bm: Malaysia: KKM siasat dakwaan sakit selepas makan produk Gardenia
title.en: Malaysia: KKM probes illness claims linked to Gardenia bread and snacks

why.bm: Nota keselamatan: simpan bungkusan dan lapor gejala kepada KKM; tiada penarikan balik diumumkan.
why.en: Safety note: keep the packaging and report symptoms to KKM; no recall announced.

summary.bm: Apple menjawab pemfailan Epic berhubung dokumen komisen App Store dalam pertikaian mahkamah yang berterusan.
summary.en: Apple responded to Epic's filing on App Store commission documents in the ongoing court dispute.

title.bm: Apple balas Epic atas dakwaan menyembunyikan 122,000 dokumen
title.en: Apple fires back at Epic over claims it withheld 122,000 documents

why.bm: Kes ini boleh membentuk yuran dan peraturan App Store untuk pembangun dan pengguna.
why.en: The case could shape App Store fees and rules for developers and users.

summary.bm: TechCrunch melaporkan kerajaan UK dipaksa mendedahkan perintah rahsia yang menuntut akses kepada data pengguna Apple.
summary.en: TechCrunch reports the UK government has been forced to disclose a secret order demanding access to Apple user data.

title.bm: Kerajaan UK dipaksa dedah perintah rahsia pintu belakang Apple
title.en: UK government forced to disclose secret Apple backdoor order

why.bm: Ia menyentuh keselamatan data iCloud disulitkan untuk pengguna di seluruh dunia.
why.en: It bears on the security of encrypted iCloud data for users worldwide.

summary.bm: Notifikasi ancaman Apple 29 Okt dihantar kepada pengguna di 99 negara; menteri Thailand berkata amaran sahaja tidak membuktikan peranti dijejaskan dan tiada bukti kaitan dengan Pegasus. SecurityWeek turut menerangkan bagaimana Secure Exclaves Apple melindungi data kamera dan mikrofon.
summary.en: Apple's 29 Oct threat notifications went to users in 99 countries; Thailand's minister said alerts alone do not show a device was compromised and no evidence links it to Pegasus. SecurityWeek separately explained how Apple's Secure Exclaves protect camera and microphone data.

title.bm: Apple bertemu pegawai Thailand berhubung amaran perisian intip selepas notifikasi ancaman 29 Okt
title.en: Apple meets Thai officials over spyware alerts sent after its 29 Oct threat notifications

why.bm: Jika menerima amaran ancaman Apple, kemas kini iOS dan pertimbangkan Mod Lockdown.
why.en: If you receive an Apple threat alert, update iOS and consider Lockdown Mode.

summary.bm: Nasihat menyenaraikan kira-kira sembilan kelemahan dalam sembang kumpulan iMessage, pasangan Bluetooth dan AirPlay; Apple tidak menyatakan ada yang dieksploitasi.
summary.en: The advisory lists around nine vulnerabilities in iMessage group chat, Bluetooth pairing and AirPlay; Apple did not say any was exploited.

title.bm: Apple keluarkan pembaikan keselamatan iOS/macOS 27.2.1, serta iOS 26.7.3 dan 18.7.12 untuk peranti lama
title.en: Apple ships iOS/macOS 27.2.1 security fixes, plus iOS 26.7.3 and 18.7.12 for older devices

why.bm: Kemas kini melalui Settings > General > Software Update.
why.en: Update via Settings > General > Software Update.

summary.bm: Choi Won-Joon mengambil alih bahagian mudah alih Samsung buat kali pertama dalam beberapa tahun.
summary.en: Choi Won-Joon takes charge of Samsung's mobile division for the first time in years.

title.bm: Bahagian mudah alih Samsung dapat ketua baharu selepas pelancaran Galaxy Z Fold 8
title.en: Samsung's mobile division gets a new head after Galaxy Z Fold 8 launch

why.bm: Perubahan kepimpinan boleh mempengaruhi harga dan hala tuju produk Galaxy.
why.en: Leadership changes can steer Galaxy pricing and product direction.

summary.bm: Laman utama Carian Google mendapat bar sisi sejarah sembang Gemini.
summary.en: The Google Search homepage is getting a Gemini chat-history sidebar.

title.bm: Laman utama Google lancar reka bentuk baharu berfokuskan AI dengan sembang Gemini anda
title.en: Google homepage rolls out AI-focused redesign with your Gemini chats

why.bm: Mengubah cara pengguna harian mencapai AI melalui Carian.
why.en: Changes how everyday users reach AI from Search.

summary.bm: Android Police berkata sesetengah pengguna Pixel 11 Pro dan Pro XL melihat skrin hitam atau ralat pada aplikasi kamera, berdasarkan hantaran pengguna dan bukan kerosakan meluas yang disahkan. Google belum mengeluarkan pembaikan rasmi; mematikan telefon 1–2 minit membantu sekurang-kurangnya seorang pengguna.
summary.en: Android Police says some Pixel 11 Pro and Pro XL users see a black screen or error in the camera app, based on user posts rather than a confirmed widespread fault. Google has not issued an official fix; powering off for 1–2 minutes helped at least one user.

title.bm: Pemilik Pixel lapor pepijat kamera dan lain-lain selepas kemas kini Android 17 November
title.en: Pixel owners report camera and other bugs after the Android 17 November update

why.bm: Jika terjejas, mulakan semula dan tunggu pembaikan Google.
why.en: If affected, restart and watch for Google's fix before rolling back.

summary.bm: Malay Mail dan Bernama melaporkan PM berkata Malaysia kekal komited kepada diplomasi dalam isu Laut China Selatan dan pendatang Myanmar. Dasar Keselamatan Negara baharu turut meletakkan keselamatan siber sebagai keutamaan tersendiri.
summary.en: Malay Mail and Bernama report the PM said Malaysia stays committed to diplomacy on South China Sea issues and on Myanmar migrants. The new National Security Policy also lists cybersecurity as a separate priority.

title.bm: Anwar di pelancaran dasar keselamatan negara: diplomasi diutamakan bagi pelarian Myanmar dan Laut China Selatan; keselamatan siber diberi keutamaan tersendiri
title.en: Anwar at national security policy launch: diplomacy first on Myanmar refugees and South China Sea; cybersecurity gets its own priority

why.bm: Menentukan hala tuju kerajaan terhadap ancaman sempadan, maritim dan siber yang menjejaskan rakyat serta pengendali IT.
why.en: Sets the government's direction on border, maritime and cyber threats that affect everyday Malaysians and IT operators.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan Menteri Dalam Negeri berkata polis tidak menemui bukti kerajaan meluluskan surat 2018 kepada CIA oleh bekas ketua perisik yang menyokong Najib.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports the home minister said police found no evidence the government approved the 2018 letter to the CIA by a former spy chief supporting Najib.

title.bm: Menteri Dalam Negeri: polis tiada bukti kelulusan kerajaan bagi surat CIA 2018 bekas ketua perisik menyokong Najib
title.en: Home minister: police find no evidence of government approval for ex-spy chief's 2018 CIA letter backing Najib

why.bm: Mengekalkan kontroversi pengampunan dan tahanan rumah Najib di pusat politik negara.
why.en: Keeps the Najib pardon and house-arrest controversy at the centre of national politics.

summary.bm: Reuters melaporkan serangan Rusia merosakkan tapak tenaga dan gas Ukraine serta memutuskan bekalan elektrik di lima wilayah, manakala peluru berpandu balistik menghentam Kyiv dengan tujuh cedera, kata datuk bandar. Ukraine mendakwa menyerang sebuah pangkalan udara utama Rusia dan merosakkan lima pesawat; Zelenskiy memberi amaran serangan besar lain dalam beberapa hari.
summary.en: Reuters reports a Russian attack damaged Ukrainian energy and gas sites and cut power in five regions, and ballistic missiles hit Kyiv leaving seven wounded, the mayor said. Ukraine says it struck a major Russian air base damaging five planes, and Zelenskiy warned of another mass strike in coming days.

title.bm: Zelenskiy: Rusia bersiap serangan besar-besaran baharu selepas serangan putuskan bekalan elektrik lima wilayah dan hentam Kyiv
title.en: Zelenskiy says Russia is preparing a new mass strike after attacks cut power in five regions and hit Kyiv

why.bm: Serangan ke atas tenaga pada musim sejuk mengekalkan risiko keselamatan Eropah dan harga tenaga.
why.en: Winter attacks on energy keep Europe's security and energy-price risks elevated.

summary.bm: 9to5Google melaporkan model baharu OpenAI dan Anthropic menimbulkan kebimbangan keselamatan dan kawalan, merujuk satu laporan. Butiran terhad dalam sumber yang dilihat.
summary.en: 9to5Google reports that new models from OpenAI and Anthropic are sounding alarms on safety and control, citing a report. Details are limited in the source seen.

title.bm: Laporan: model baharu OpenAI dan Anthropic menimbulkan kebimbangan keselamatan dan kawalan
title.en: Report: new OpenAI and Anthropic models raise safety and control concerns

why.bm: Penemuan keselamatan boleh mempengaruhi peraturan dan alat AI yang sanggup digunakan syarikat.
why.en: Safety findings can shape regulation and which AI tools firms are willing to adopt.

summary.bm: Polis mengklasifikasi semula perlanggaran kereta-motosikal yang membunuh seorang lelaki di bawah Seksyen 302 Kanun Keseksaan selepas menemui unsur kecurian kabel, susulan video Facebook. Telekom Malaysia membuat laporan dan polis menjejak suspek.
summary.en: Police reclassified a car-motorcycle collision that killed one man under Penal Code Section 302 after finding elements of cable theft, following a Facebook video. Telekom Malaysia lodged a report and police are tracking suspects.

title.bm: Kemalangan maut di Iskandar Puteri kini disiasat sebagai pembunuhan, dikaitkan kecurian kabel
title.en: Fatal Iskandar Puteri crash now a murder probe over suspected cable-theft link

why.bm: Kecurian kabel menjadi isu keselamatan dan gangguan telekomunikasi.
why.en: Cable theft is rising as a safety and telecom-outage issue.

summary.bm: MOF berkata RON97 turun kepada RM3.75, RON95 tanpa subsidi RM3.47 dan diesel tanpa subsidi RM4.47 seliter bagi 26 Nov–2 Dis menerusi Mekanisme Harga Automatik. BUDI95 kekal RM1.99 dan BUDI Diesel RM2.10 seliter.
summary.en: MOF says RON97 falls to RM3.75, unsubsidised RON95 to RM3.47 and unsubsidised diesel to RM4.47 per litre for 26 Nov–2 Dec under the Automatic Pricing Mechanism. BUDI95 stays at RM1.99 and BUDI Diesel at RM2.10 per litre.

title.bm: Harga RON97, RON95 dan diesel tanpa subsidi turun 25 sen mulai hari ini
title.en: Unsubsidised RON97, RON95 and diesel down 25 sen from today

why.bm: Harga pam lebih rendah untuk pengguna tanpa subsidi, namun MOF mengingatkan risiko geopolitik masih boleh menjejaskan bekalan.
why.en: Lower pump prices for non-subsidised users, though MOF warns geopolitical risk could still disrupt supply.

summary.bm: Polis berkata juruterbang itu penyelaras dan pengangkut dalam sindiket berkaitan rampasan dadah 96.6kg. Mindef bertindak melindungi anggota TUDM yang membuat tangkapan.
summary.en: Police say the pilot was both coordinator and transporter in a ring tied to a 96.6kg drug find. Mindef is moving to protect RMAF personnel who made the arrests.

title.bm: Juruterbang TUDM dalam kes syabu Subang berperanan ganda untuk sindiket dadah, kata Bukit Aman
title.en: RMAF pilot in Subang meth haul played a double role for the drug ring, says Bukit Aman

why.bm: Menimbulkan persoalan tentang keselamatan di pangkalan udara tentera.
why.en: Raises questions about security at military airbases.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan MetMalaysia mengeluarkan amaran hujan berterusan untuk Terengganu dan sebahagian Kelantan sehingga Ahad.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports MetMalaysia issued a continuous-rain warning for Terengganu and parts of Kelantan lasting until Sunday.

title.bm: MetMalaysia beri amaran hujan berterusan di Terengganu dan sebahagian Kelantan hingga Ahad
title.en: MetMalaysia warns of continuous rain in Terengganu and parts of Kelantan until Sunday

why.bm: Semak amaran banjir rasmi sebelum bergerak di Pantai Timur.
why.en: Check official flood warnings before travelling on the east coast.

summary.bm: Imigresen berkata pengecualian visa untuk warga India tamat pada 1 Januari 2027 apabila Malaysia memperketat semakan sebelum ketibaan. Permohonan dibuka di MyVISA mulai 1 Disember 2026.
summary.en: Immigration says the visa exemption for Indian nationals ends on 1 January 2027 as Malaysia tightens pre-arrival checks. Applications open on MyVISA from 1 December 2026.

title.bm: Kemasukan bebas visa untuk warga India tamat 1 Jan 2027; permohonan MyVISA dibuka 1 Dis
title.en: Visa-free entry for Indian nationals ends 1 Jan 2027; MyVISA applications open 1 Dec

why.bm: Pelancong dan pengendali pelancongan perlu merancang visa lebih awal.
why.en: Travellers and tourism operators must plan visas ahead.

summary.bm: Pusat pemindahan Selangor menempatkan 958 orang daripada 281 keluarga pada waktu petang. Putrajaya turut melaksanakan tiga projek segera untuk Shah Alam dan menyasarkan penyelesaian lebih besar bernilai RM40 juta.
summary.en: Selangor relief centres held 958 people from 281 families in the afternoon. Putrajaya also rolled out three immediate projects for flood-hit Shah Alam, eyeing a bigger RM40m fix.

title.bm: Terengganu pulih daripada banjir, Selangor bersiap sedia; mangsa hampir 1,000
title.en: Terengganu emerges from floods as Selangor braces; evacuees near 1,000

why.bm: Semak amaran banjir rasmi sebelum bergerak.
why.en: Check official flood warnings before travelling.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan KPN mengesahkan siasatan terhadap kedua-dua ahli politik berhubung dua perkara itu.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports the IGP confirmed investigations into both politicians over the two matters.

title.bm: KPN: polis siasat Tony Pua berhubung hantaran pengampunan Najib dan Khoo Poay Tiong berkaitan ucapan solat Jumaat
title.en: IGP: police probing Tony Pua over Najib pardon post and Khoo Poay Tiong over Friday prayer remarks

why.bm: Menunjukkan cara polis mengendalikan kes ucapan yang sensitif dari segi politik.
why.en: Shows how police are handling politically sensitive speech cases.

summary.bm: Perkhidmatan disambung semula pada 10.09 pagi selepas Rapid KL membaiki bekalan kuasa landasan yang menjejaskan stesen Subang Jaya, Glenmarie, Ara Damansara dan Lembah Subang. Tren dan bas ulang-alik percuma disediakan semasa gangguan.
summary.en: Services resumed at 10.09am after Rapid KL repaired the track power supply affecting Subang Jaya, Glenmarie, Ara Damansara and Lembah Subang. Shuttle trains and free buses ran during the disruption.

title.bm: Perkhidmatan LRT Kelana Jaya pulih selepas gangguan kuasa di empat stesen
title.en: Kelana Jaya LRT restored after power fault at four stations

why.bm: Penumpang laluan ini berdepan kelewatan pagi tadi tetapi perkhidmatan kini normal.
why.en: Commuters on the line faced delays this morning but services are normal.

summary.bm: Anwar menafikan kerajaan membocorkan minit Lembaga Pengampunan berkaitan tahanan rumah Najib, dengan berkata AGC hanya menyahklasifikasi sebahagian untuk prosiding mahkamah. Beliau meminta KDN menyiasat kebocoran terdahulu; Mahkamah Tinggi pada 10 Nov memerintahkan Najib menjalani baki hukuman SRC di rumah. Pada 24 Nov, Anwar menafikan kerajaan membocorkan minit Lembaga Pengampunan.
summary.en: Anwar denied the government leaked Pardons Board minutes on Najib's house arrest, saying the AGC only declassified parts for court proceedings. He asked the Home Ministry to probe the earlier leak; the High Court ordered Najib to serve the rest of his SRC sentence under house arrest on 10 Nov. On 24 Nov Anwar denied the government leaked the Pardons Board minutes.

title.bm: Minit tahanan rumah Najib dinyahrahsia bagi membolehkan kerajaan menjawab Majlis Peguam di mahkamah
title.en: Najib house-arrest minutes declassified so govt can answer Malaysian Bar in court

why.bm: Ujian penting ketelusan dalam proses pengampunan.
why.en: A key test of transparency in the pardons process.

summary.bm: Panel Mahkamah Persekutuan membatalkan permohonan kebenaran Najib selepas kedua-dua pihak bersetuju beliau membayar kos RM10,000. Peguamnya berkata anak guamnya mahu menumpukan perhatian kepada isu mendesak.
summary.en: A Federal Court bench struck out Najib's leave application after both sides agreed he would pay RM10,000 in costs. His lawyer said he wanted to focus on pressing issues.

title.bm: Najib tarik balik permohonan akhir hidupkan semula saman RM1.9 juta terhadap bekas AG Tommy Thomas
title.en: Najib drops final bid to revive RM1.9m suit against ex-AG Tommy Thomas

why.bm: Menamatkan kes sivil berlarutan berkaitan pendakwaan 1MDB.
why.en: Ends a long-running civil case tied to the 1MDB prosecution.

summary.bm: Sasterawan Negara itu, yang meninggal dunia pada usia 91 tahun, selamat dikebumikan di Bukit Kiara. Penghormatan terus diberikan oleh komuniti sastera.
summary.en: The National Laureate, who died aged 91, was laid to rest at Bukit Kiara. Tributes continue from the literary community.

title.bm: Sasterawan Negara A. Samad Said dikebumikan di Bukit Kiara
title.en: National Laureate A. Samad Said laid to rest at Bukit Kiara

why.bm: Menandakan pemergian salah seorang tokoh sastera terpenting negara.
why.en: Marks the passing of one of Malaysia's most important literary figures.

summary.bm: Abdul Karim Rahman Hamzah dari GPS menolak dakwaan Pengerusi DAP Sarawak Chong Chieng Jen bahawa keputusan PKR tidak bertanding mengorbankan demokrasi. Beliau mengalu-alukan PKR, Umno, Amanah dan Bersatu tidak bertanding dalam pilihan raya 12 Dis.
summary.en: GPS's Abdul Karim Rahman Hamzah rejected Sarawak DAP chief Chong Chieng Jen's claim that PKR's decision not to contest sacrificed democracy. He welcomed PKR, Umno, Amanah and Bersatu staying out of the 12 Dec election.

title.bm: GPS: tidak bertanding PRN Sarawak pilihan demokratik, kata kepada DAP
title.en: GPS: sitting out Sarawak polls is a democratic choice, tells DAP

why.bm: Mempengaruhi persaingan menjelang hari mengundi Sarawak 12 Disember.
why.en: Shapes the contest ahead of Sarawak's 12 December polling day.

summary.bm: Chong Chieng Jen berkata 'sifar pembangkang' tidak boleh diterima apabila DAP meletakkan 12 calon. PKR tidak bertanding, namun ketua PKR Lawas mungkin bertanding solo di Bukit Sari.
summary.en: Chong Chieng Jen says 'zero opposition' is a no-go as DAP fields 12 candidates. PKR sits out the contest, though its Lawas chief may run solo in Bukit Sari.

title.bm: PRN Sarawak 12 Dis: DAP letak 12 calon; PKR tidak bertanding
title.en: Sarawak polls on 12 Dec: DAP fields 12 candidates; PKR sits out

why.bm: Penanda aras untuk PRU16 dan hubungan dalam kerajaan perpaduan.
why.en: A bellwether for GE16 and relations in the unity government.

summary.bm: MCMC memfailkan saman RM300 juta terhadap Google LLC kerana penyiaran semula kandungan berunsur fitnah di YouTube, lapor Sinar Harian.
summary.en: MCMC filed a RM300m suit against Google LLC over republished defamatory content on YouTube, Sinar Harian reports.

title.bm: MCMC saman Google RM300 juta berhubung kandungan fitnah di YouTube
title.en: MCMC sues Google for RM300 million over defamatory content on YouTube

why.bm: Kes ujian untuk akauntabiliti platform di Malaysia.
why.en: A test case for platform accountability in Malaysia.

summary.bm: Mahkamah Tinggi menolak permohonan yang mencabar penarikan subsidi diesel.
summary.en: The High Court dismissed an application challenging the removal of the diesel subsidy.

title.bm: Mahkamah Tinggi menolak permohonan mencabar penarikan subsidi diesel
title.en: High Court dismisses bid to challenge diesel subsidy removal

why.bm: Dasar subsidi diesel bersasar kerajaan kekal dilaksanakan.
why.en: Leaves the government's targeted diesel subsidy policy intact.

summary.bm: Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim mengarahkan siasatan terhadap seorang Ahli Parlimen berhubung kenyataan mengenai penutupan solat Jumaat. Butiran kenyataan tidak disahkan dalam sumber yang disemak.
summary.en: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has directed an investigation into an MP over remarks about Friday prayer closures. Details of the remarks were not confirmed in the sources checked.

title.bm: Anwar arah siasatan terhadap Ahli Parlimen berhubung kenyataan penutupan solat Jumaat
title.en: Anwar directs probe into MP over remarks on Friday prayer closures

why.bm: Menyentuh sensitiviti agama di Parlimen.
why.en: Touches on religious sensitivities in Parliament.

summary.bm: Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil berkata MySiren, yang dilancarkan pada 23 Nov, hanya menghantar notifikasi dan tidak mengakses data peribadi pemilik peranti.
summary.en: Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil says MySiren, launched on 23 Nov, only sends notifications and has no access to device owners' personal data.

title.bm: Sistem amaran awal kebangsaan MySiren dilancarkan; amaran terus ke telefon tanpa aplikasi
title.en: MySiren national early warning system goes live; alerts go straight to phones with no app needed

why.bm: Amaran bencana seperti banjir sampai ke telefon tanpa perlu memasang apa-apa.
why.en: Alerts for disasters such as floods reach phones without installing anything.

summary.bm: Pearly Tan dan M. Thinaah menjuarai beregu wanita Hong Kong Terbuka, menamatkan penantian 26 tahun Malaysia dalam acara itu, ketika pasangan Malaysia menyapu bersih gelaran beregu.
summary.en: Pearly Tan and M. Thinaah won the Hong Kong Open women's doubles, ending a 26-year wait for Malaysia in the event, as Malaysian pairs swept the doubles titles.

title.bm: Pearly Tan–M. Thinaah tamatkan penantian 26 tahun, Malaysia sapu bersih gelaran beregu Hong Kong
title.en: Pearly Tan–M. Thinaah end 26-year drought as Malaysia sweep Hong Kong doubles titles

why.bm: Suntikan semangat buat badminton negara.
why.en: A morale boost for national badminton.

summary.bm: Saifuddin berkata tangkapan lanjut mungkin dibuat selepas rampasan dadah 96.6kg di sebuah pangkalan udara. Dua lagi anggota TUDM di Tawau direman ketika siasatan penyeludupan dadah membabitkan tentera diperluas.
summary.en: Saifuddin said further arrests may follow the 96.6kg drug find at an air base. Two more RMAF personnel in Tawau were remanded as the military drug-smuggling probe widens.

title.bm: Kerajaan pertimbang kawalan keselamatan lebih ketat di pangkalan tentera dan polis selepas rampasan dadah 96.6kg; dua lagi anggota TUDM Tawau direman
title.en: Govt mulls tighter security at military and police bases after 96.6kg drug find; two more Tawau RMAF personnel remanded

why.bm: Menimbulkan persoalan keselamatan di dalam kemudahan angkatan tentera.
why.en: Raises questions on security inside armed forces facilities.

summary.bm: Kerajaan menyatakan subsidi jagaan kanak-kanak RM180 adalah jumlah maksimum yang mampu disediakan buat masa ini.
summary.en: The government says the RM180 childcare subsidy is the most it can afford at present.

title.bm: Subsidi jagaan kanak-kanak RM180: Kerajaan kata itu sahaja yang mampu
title.en: RM180 childcare subsidy: Govt says that is all it can afford

why.bm: Memberi kesan kepada ibu bapa bekerja yang merancang kos jagaan anak.
why.en: Affects working parents budgeting for childcare.

summary.bm: Johor mengemukakan dasar memberi keutamaan kepada rakyat Malaysia untuk jawatan juruwang dan memperketat peraturan pekerja asing.
summary.en: Johor put forward a policy to give Malaysians priority for cashier jobs and to tighten rules on foreign workers.

title.bm: Johor cadang dasar juruwang rakyat Malaysia diutamakan dan peraturan lebih ketat pekerja asing
title.en: Johor proposes Malaysians-first cashier policy and tighter rules for foreign workers

why.bm: Boleh membuka lebih peluang kerja kepada penduduk tempatan dalam sektor runcit.
why.en: May widen job access for locals in retail.

summary.en: Sabah is waiting for a RM900m federal grant, its minister said.

title.bm: Masidi: Sabah menunggu geran persekutuan RM900j menjelang Bajet 2027 di tengah ketidaktentuan hasil minyak
title.en: Masidi: Sabah awaits RM900m federal grant ahead of 2027 Budget amid oil revenue uncertainty

why.bm: Menjejaskan pembiayaan negeri Sabah.
why.en: Affects Sabah state funding.

summary.bm: Kertas bertulis berlangsung 23 Nov hingga 17 Dis di 3,334 pusat, dan PM Anwar menggesa calon bertenang. Ujian lisan dan bertulis bahasa kini diadakan pada hari sama bagi mengurangkan ketidakhadiran.
summary.en: Written papers run 23 Nov to 17 Dec at 3,334 centres, and PM Anwar urged candidates to stay calm. Listening and written language papers are now held on one day to cut absenteeism.

title.bm: 420,879 calon duduki SPM 2026; KPM satukan kertas Bahasa Melayu dan Inggeris pada hari sama
title.en: 420,879 candidates sit SPM 2026; MOE moves Bahasa Melayu and English papers to the same day

why.bm: Memberi kesan kepada ratusan ribu pelajar dan keluarga bulan ini.
why.en: Affects hundreds of thousands of students and families this month.

summary.bm: Timbalan Menteri Sumber Manusia Khairul Firdaus berkata hanya pekerja asing tanpa rekod jenayah dibenarkan masuk melalui sistem bersepadu dengan polis. Seramai 2.082 juta pemegang PLKS direkodkan setakat 15 Okt, dengan 241,178 kuota 2026 berbaki.
summary.en: Deputy Human Resources Minister Khairul Firdaus says only foreign workers with no criminal record are admitted, via a system linked to police. 2.082 million PLKS holders were recorded as of 15 Oct, with 241,178 left in the 2026 quota.

title.bm: Pekerja asing disaring dengan rekod polis; nisbah PLKS diturunkan kepada 10% menjelang 2030
title.en: Foreign workers screened with police records; PLKS ratio to fall to 10% by 2030

why.bm: Memberi kesan kepada majikan yang mengambil pekerja asing dan kebimbangan keselamatan awam.
why.en: Affects employers hiring foreign labour and public safety concerns.

summary.bm: Di Dialog Negara, Malay Mail melaporkan PM menegaskan penjagaan kesihatan awam kekal mampu milik dan menolak bayaran klinik yang lebih mahal.
summary.en: At the Dialog Negara, Malay Mail reports the PM insisted public healthcare stay affordable and rejected costlier clinic visits.

title.bm: Anwar: tiada kenaikan kos klinik, penjagaan kesihatan awam mesti kekal mampu milik
title.en: Anwar: no to pricier clinic visits, public healthcare must stay affordable

why.bm: Menjejaskan bayaran klinik rakyat biasa.
why.en: Affects clinic fees for ordinary Malaysians.
